assessments.reasoning: The pinned publisher LICENSE.md was delivered in full at 475 bytes with SHA-256 d04a8527e90a7f7fe36083fa1fd25db16b0e43c2244f4f6880f7a2c5d18c631e. The tool supplied no separate range. The broad contributor copyright grant encompasses copying and redistribution, and the next paragraph expressly triggers the removal requirement upon modification. The grant is limited to the contributing party's copyright in the license document.

As contextual evidence, the publisher heading and versioned URL in [0, 100), SHA-256 24b4eb2cac0bf998fd63acc5e89413e90851e3a326d90f7e2f799437cd3c575e, identify PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0.md as a PolyForm license in the same pinned repository and commit as LICENSE.md. The delivered full file is 4563 bytes and its reported SHA-256 c0ea4a896d2c8c394b29f9427589996db826cd501c512279ff0ed3ef48fabbe5 matches the claim's provenance. That evidence connects the named file to the class of documents addressed by the rights statement. The permission itself comes from LICENSE.md.

challenge.method: Tested whether the modification condition reaches unchanged copies, whether software conditions govern reproduction of the publisher document, and whether the same-commit document and comparison controls establish the exact file within the grant's documentary scope.
challenge.results: The removal condition is triggered by changes. The software terms address a distinct copyrighted subject. The same-commit heading identifies the target file as a PolyForm license and the full Markdown measurement matches the record's provenance. The Small Business excerpt identifies a different edition, and the official plain-text control has a different source-wide digest despite its matching heading and byte count. Neither substitution establishes the claimed exact Markdown. The tested evidence presents no material contradiction.

limitations: The finding is limited to each contributor's copyright covered by the statement and the exact unchanged Markdown.
Modified copies, branding and other rights, permission concerning licensed software, and the bytes of any actual reproduction fall outside this finding.
Integrity checks use the fresh tool-reported measurements and inspection of the delivered bytes and text.
reasoning: The acquired 1531-byte revision 1 record reports the requested digest and limits the claim to byte-preserving reproduction of the pinned publisher Markdown. The repository copyright statement grants permission broad enough to copy and redistribute that document unchanged as to each contributor's own copyright covered by the grant. Changes to a PolyForm license separately require removing all mentions of PolyForm and polyformproject.org. The software terms govern rights and obligations concerning software offered by a licensor. The repository copyright statement governs the contributors' copyright in the license document.
